_comment: Vihar reminder pictures: the line printed on the wide notification picture. scripts/notify-images.mjs draws public/notify/reminder-<key>.jpg for each (on assets/Pilgrims Walking Toward Sunrise.png) (and the SSG versions); the Captain picks one in Profile & Settings. Keys must stay lowercase-and-dashes; add a line here, then run node scripts/notify-images.mjs.
